items.title: Rudy Mazzari Interview, 1959-11-06
items.q: you see a guy down the street and say, where you at, Joe?

ctx.x: How did the other musicians react when he came here?

Oh, they'd just break out in a big smile, you know. If they had been bored, well, they weren't bored anymore when he walked in, I'll tell you that. The guy actually would throw sunshine. That's how good he was. Not only his plane, but his personality. He was a nice guy. He really was. He was a good Joe. Just ate too much, huh? Yeah, too many oysters. I guess.
I think that's what killed him. I'm not sure. All that easy.
